claim: ElevenLabs was founded in 2022 by Polish entrepreneurs Piotr Dąbkowski and Mateusz (Mati) Staniszewski.
quote: It was founded in 2022 by Polish entrepreneurs Piotr Dąbkowski and Mateusz Staniszewski. ... ElevenLabs was co-founded in 2022 by Piotr Dąbkowski, an ex-Google machine learning engineer and Mati Staniszewski, an ex-Palantir deployment strategist.

claim: The motivation and initial inspiration for founding ElevenLabs came from growing up in Poland and being frustrated by the terrible, emotionless voice dubbing in American Hollywood movies.
quote: Both were raised in Poland, and their inspiration for founding ElevenLabs reportedly came from watching inadequately dubbed American films.

claim: The name ElevenLabs derives from the English word eleven, referring to November 11 (Poland's National Independence Day), and Labs referring to its research and development profile.
quote: The name ElevenLabs derives from the English word eleven. The number refers to November 11, the date of Poland’s National Independence Day (the eleventh day of the eleventh month). The element Labs refers to the English word laboratories and indicates the company’s research and development profile.

claim: ElevenLabs was co-founded in 2022 in London by childhood friends from Poland Mati Staniszewski (CEO) and Piotr Dąbkowski (CTO).
quote: It was co-founded in 2022 in London by childhood friends from Poland Mati Staniszewski (CEO) and Piotr Dąbkowski (CTO).

claim: ElevenLabs raised a $2 million pre-seed funding round in late 2022 / announced in January 2023, led by Credo Ventures and Concept Ventures, along with several angel investors.
quote: Today, they announced launching their Beta platform after raising $2 million in a pre-seed funding round led by Credo Ventures, with Concept Ventures and other individual investors also participating.

claim: ElevenLabs officially launched its Beta platform in January 2023, allowing creators and publishers to convert text to speech using deep learning models and custom voice cloning.
quote: ElevenLabs, an AI voice technology startup, is building lifelike speech synthesis tools with the long-term goal of instantly converting spoken audio between languages. Today, they announced launching their Beta platform after raising $2 million in a pre-seed funding round...

claim: In June 2023, ElevenLabs raised a $19 million Series A funding round co-led by Andreessen Horowitz, Nat Friedman, and Daniel Gross, with Andreessen Horowitz taking a board seat.
quote: ElevenLabs is announcing today that it has raised a $19m Series A round co-led by Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, and Andreessen Horowitz, with further participation from Credo Ventures, Concept Ventures, and an array of strategic angel investors... Andreessen Horowitz is taking a board seat.

claim: By June 2023, just months after its Beta launch, ElevenLabs had reached over 1 million registered users.
quote: AI platform ElevenLabs, which launched in Beta in January 2023, has now attracted over 1 million registered users across creative, entertainment and publishing spaces

claim: Em 22 de janeiro de 2024, a ElevenLabs levantou US$ 80 milhões em uma rodada de financiamento Série B, alcançando o status de unicórnio com uma avaliação superior a US$ 1 bilhão.
quote: ElevenLabs, a startup developing AI-powered tools to create and edit synthetic voices, today announced that it closed an $80 million Series B round co-led by prominent investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman and entrepreneur Daniel Gross... brings ElevenLabs’ total raised to $101 million and values the company at over $1 billion

claim: A rodada Série B contou com a participação de Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Nat Friedman, Daniel Gross, Sequoia Capital, Smash Capital, SV Angel, BroadLight Capital e Credo Ventures, elevando o total captado pela empresa para US$ 101 milhões.
quote: co-led by prominent investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman and entrepreneur Daniel Gross. The round, which also had participation from Sequoia Capital, Smash Capital, SV Angel, BroadLight Capital and Credo Ventures, brings ElevenLabs’ total raised to $101 million

claim: Até janeiro de 2024, a plataforma da ElevenLabs já era utilizada por funcionários de 41% das empresas da Fortune 500 e a equipe planejava expandir de 40 para 100 funcionários até o final do ano.
quote: Staniszewski claims that ElevenLab users have generated the equivalent of more than 100 years of audio and that the platform is being used by employees at 41% of Fortune 500 companies.

claim: No anúncio da Série B em janeiro de 2024, a ElevenLabs revelou parcerias comerciais com grandes players em setores como publicação (Storytel, The Washington Post, Curio), jogos (Paradox Interactive, NetEase, Inworld AI), mídia (Wondershare Filmora, Futuri Media) e IA conversacional (FlowGPT).
quote: Throughout 2023, ElevenLabs has also expanded its presence in multiple sectors, including publishing, gaming, media, and conversational verticals, as well as forging B2B partnerships with major media houses, among them: - Publishing : Storytel, The Washington Post, Rheinische Post, Curio - Conversational AI : FlowGPT, SimpleTalk AI, Ollang, VoiceDrop, Vana - Media & Entertainment : Wondershare Filmora, Futuri Media, TheSoul Publishing - Gaming : Paradox Interactive, NetEase, Inworld AI

claim: Ao alcançar o status de unicórnio em janeiro de 2024, a ElevenLabs havia expandido sua equipe de 5 para 40 funcionários e seus usuários já haviam gerado o equivalente a mais de 100 anos de áudio.
quote: Since launch, ElevenLabs’ users have generated over 100 years of audio, while the firm grew from 5 to 40 employees . Today, ElevenLabs technology is being used by employees at 41% of Fortune 500 companies.

claim: Em janeiro de 2023, a ElevenLabs lançou publicamente sua plataforma beta de síntese de fala e clonagem de voz, permitindo aos usuários gerar áudio realista e clonar vozes a partir de amostras.
quote: In January 2023, ElevenLabs publicly released its beta platform . [...] Paying users are given the ability to upload custom voice samples to create new vocal styles using the company's voice cloning tool.

claim: Em junho de 2023, a ElevenLabs lançou o AI Speech Classifier, ferramenta criada para identificar se um arquivo de áudio foi gerado pela tecnologia de IA da própria empresa.
quote: On June 20, 2023, ElevenLabs released an AI recognition tool called the AI Speech Classifier, which it claims is the first of its kind. [...] designed to determine if an uploaded audio sample originates from ElevenLabs' proprietary AI technology.

claim: Em 2023, a ElevenLabs lançou o ferramenta Projects (julho/setembro) para conteúdos de longo formato como audiolivros, expandiu para 28 idiomas em agosto saindo da fase beta, e em outubro lançou o AI Dubbing para traduzir falas em mais de 20 idiomas mantendo a voz e emoção originais.
quote: In July 2023, ElevenLabs announced "Projects", a tool for creating long-form spoken content such as audiobooks and dialogue segments with contextually-aware synthetic or custom voices. [...] In August, ElevenLabs expanded its voice generation capabilities to 28 languages. [...] In October 2023, ElevenLabs presented "AI Dubbing", a tool that is able to translate speech into more than 20 languages.

claim: Em 2024, a ElevenLabs lançou o Voice Marketplace e AI Dubbing Studio (janeiro), o aplicativo ElevenReader/ElevenLabs Reader App para ouvir textos em iOS/Android (junho/agosto), o Voice Isolator para remoção de ruído (julho) e a plataforma Conversational AI para agentes de voz interativos (novembro).
quote: Additionally, the company announced a series of new products, including their Voice Marketplace, AI Dubbing Studio, and mobile app. [...] In June 2024, ElevenLabs released the ElevenLabs Reader App on iOS and Android which allows users to listen to articles, PDFs, and ePubs with AI Voices on their phone. In July 2024, ElevenLabs released "Voice Isolator" which removes background noise from audio. In November 2024, they released Conversational AI, a developer platform for launching interactive vo

claim: Em 2025 e 2026, a ElevenLabs lançou o modelo de transcrição Scribe (fevereiro de 2025), o modelo Eleven v3 com suporte a mais de 70 idiomas e tags de áudio emocionais (junho de 2025), o gerador de música Eleven Music (agosto de 2025) e o Expressive Mode no ElevenAgents (fevereiro de 2026).
quote: Later that month, the company released Scribe, a speech-to-text model that transcribes audio with character-level timestamps and speaker diarization [...] In June 2025, ElevenLabs released Eleven v3, a new text-to-speech model that supports more than 70 languages, natural multi-speaker dialogue, and audio tags like [excited], [whispers], and [sighs]. [...] In August 2025, ElevenLabs launched Eleven Music, an AI music generator that enables users to generate studio-grade music from natural langua

claim: Em 2026, a plataforma ElevenLabs é estruturada em três famílias de produtos: ElevenCreative (ferramentas de geração e edição para criadores), ElevenAgents (plataforma de agentes conversacionais de atendimento) e ElevenAPI (para desenvolvedores integrarem recursos de áudio IA).
quote: ElevenLabs’ offerings can be understood through three main product families, each designed for a different type of user or workflow. ElevenCreative provides no-code tools for generating, editing and localizing audio and visual content. [...] ElevenAgents is a platform for building, deploying and managing conversational AI agents [...] ElevenAPI allows software developers to integrate text-to-speech, transcription and other generative audio capabilities into their own applications via API .

claim: Entre 2025 e 2026, a ElevenLabs expandiu significativamente seu portfólio de IA, evoluindo de uma plataforma de voz para uma solução completa de IA generativa (áudio, música, transcrição, agentes de voz e vídeo).
quote: The platform launched as Conversational AI before becoming ElevenLabs Agents and later ElevenAgents. ... ElevenLabs also previews custom model fine-tuning for businesses. ... ElevenLabs used its first NYC Summit, on November 11, 2026, to launch 13 new products and updates, repositioning itself from a voice generation startup to a full-stack enterprise AI platform.

claim: A ElevenLabs expandiu seu portfólio de 2025 a 2026, lançando produtos como ElevenMusic, Scribe, ElevenAgents e a série de modelos Eleven v4.
quote: ElevenMusic launches as a music listening, remixing, and creation platform ... Scribe launches as ElevenLabs’ first speech-to-text model ... ElevenLabs Agents becomes the new name for Conversational AI ... Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo launch in ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative, and the API.

claim: A ElevenLabs lançou o ElevenMusic, Scribe e novos modelos de voz entre 2025 e 2026.
quote: ElevenMusic launches as a music listening, remixing, and creation platform built with artists, labels, and publishers. ... Scribe launches as ElevenLabs’ first speech-to-text model, transcribing 99 languages with timestamps and speaker labels. ... Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo launch in ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative, and the API.

claim: A ElevenLabs lançou os modelos de Text to Speech 'Eleven v4' e 'Eleven v4 Turbo' em 2026.
quote: Four years later, as we reach our new valuation, we just released two new state-of-the-art Text to Speech models. Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo are our fastest and most emotive models yet, which are already leading independent benchmarks .

claim: A ElevenLabs confirmou o lançamento dos modelos Eleven v4 e v4 Turbo em setembro de 2026.
quote: Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo are our fastest and most emotive models yet, which are already leading independent benchmarks .
